entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-2cw7-v8ff-p88r: Oj: Use-After-Free in Oj::Parser Symbol Key Cache Toggle
entry.content:
Oj: Use-After-Free in Oj::Parser Symbol Key Cache Toggle

Aliases: CVE-2026-54899

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • oj — fixed in 3.17.2

### Summary Disabling `symbol_keys` on a reused `Oj::Parser` instance triggers a heap use-after-free. When `symbol_keys` is toggled from `true` to `false`, `opt_symbol_keys_set` frees the internal key cache (`cache_free`) but does not clear the pointer. The next `parse` call reads from the freed cache via `cache_intern`, producing a use-after-free. ### Version - **Software**: oj gem - **Affected**: all versions with `ext/oj/usual.c` - **Latest tested**: 3.17.1 (confirmed present) ### Details `ext/oj/usual.c`, `opt_symbol_keys_set`: ```c // usual.c:1043–1051 if (symbol_keys) { d->key_cache = cache_create(...); // allocate } else { cache_free(d->key_cache); // free — but d->key_cache pointer not NULLed } ``` On the next parse call, `cache_key` → `cache_intern` read…

entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-9ppp-w3g4-fh4q: Oj: Use-After-Free in Oj::Doc Iterators via Reentrant Close
entry.content:
Oj: Use-After-Free in Oj::Doc Iterators via Reentrant Close

Aliases: CVE-2026-54897

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • oj — fixed in 3.17.3

### Summary `Oj::Doc` iterators (`each_value`, `each_child`, `each_leaf`) are vulnerable to a heap use-after-free. When a Ruby block yielded during iteration calls `doc.close` or `d.close`, the document's heap memory is freed while the C iterator is still running. When control returns from the block, the iterator reads from the freed region, producing a use-after-free accessible from pure Ruby. ### Version - **Software**: oj gem - **Affected**: all versions with `ext/oj/fast.c` - **Latest tested**: 3.17.1 (confirmed present) ### Details The iterators in `ext/oj/fast.c` follow the pattern: ```c // fast.c:1505 (doc_each_child) static VALUE doc_each_child(VALUE self, ...) { ... while (cur != NULL) { rb_yield(...); // ← Ruby block executes here cur = cur->ne…

entry.title: [UPDATED] MAL-2026-17592: Malicious code in cryoto-toolbox (RubyGems)
entry.content:
Malicious code in cryoto-toolbox (RubyGems)

Affected:

  • cryoto-toolbox

RubyGems runs this gem's native extension script `ext/cryoto-toolbox/extconf.rb` during `gem install`. The script exits without action on CI runners and sandboxes, based on CI environment variables, the hostname, the username and the working directory. It continues if the system uptime is over 30 minutes and the home directory holds `.ssh`, `.gitconfig`, `.npmrc`, `.gem/credentials` or `.bundle`. It then decodes a Base64 Ruby payload and forks twice into a detached process. After 20 to 40 minutes the payload downloads `http://45.138.12.177:8092/wgkit.tar.gz` to `/tmp/.w1.tgz` with `curl`, extracts it to `/tmp/.w1/`, runs `wg_install.sh` with `bash` and deletes both. The payload stores the URL XOR-encoded with the key `usv\x9a`. The Ruby code in `lib/` is a decoy. The RubyGems account `reqt…

References:

  • https://rubygems.org/gems/cryoto-toolbox/versions/1.0.0
  • https://safedep.io/rubygems-crypto-gems-install-time-reverse-shell/

It then decodes a Base64 Ruby payload, forks twice into a detached process, waits 20 to 40 minutes and opens a reverse shell that connects `/bin/sh` to 45.138.12.177 on TCP port 8090. entry.title: [UPDATED] MAL-2026-17570: Malicious code in throttle-requests (RubyGems)
entry.content:
Malicious code in throttle-requests (RubyGems)

Affected:

  • throttle-requests

RubyGems runs this gem's native extension script `ext/req_throttle_mini/extconf.rb` during `gem install`. The script exits without action on CI runners and sandboxes, based on CI environment variables, the hostname, the username and the working directory. It continues if the system uptime is over 30 minutes and the home directory holds `.ssh`, `.gitconfig`, `.npmrc`, `.gem/credentials` or `.bundle`. It then decodes a Base64 Ruby payload, forks twice into a detached process, waits 20 to 40 minutes and opens a reverse shell that connects `/bin/sh` to 45.138.12.177 on TCP port 8090. The shell reconnects every 30 seconds. The Ruby code in `lib/` is a decoy. The RubyGems account `reqthrottle_3474` published this gem and 41 others with the same loader on 2026-10-05. --- _-= Per source details. …
